title: A Stop check makes the page writer export the page data after each page write
why: Owner, Nov 5 19:05 CST: "can that only live in ur handoff it cant be mechanized?" Incident: the roadmap's waiting/ copy went stale from 06:41 to 19:04 CST Nov 5 while triage wrote page items all day (decision waiting-data-in-repo).
note:
Nov 6 12:01 CST (coordinator replan: Opus plan and critic, main 7975f6d8, roadmap 01995020): DONE, evidence on main: #1288.
Nov 5 19:06 CST (triage): shape: a Stop hook in the page writer's session reads this turn's transcript. If the turn made an ArtifactData write to the registered waiting page and no later commit touched waiting/ on the record branch, it refuses the stop and names export_page.py. It reads on demand at Stop, starts no process and writes no file. Its test proves both the refusal and the pass. Until it lands, the handoff line holds it.
